decisions.decision: Translate runtime_manager directives into a runtime_control_packet command contract.
decisions.rationale: This moves FluidGateway closer to an executable manager while staying software-side and safe.

decisions.decision: Serialize reserve-headroom as reserve_memory_headroom in runtime_control_packet.
decisions.rationale: This keeps the new control packet aligned with existing dispatch and dry-run execution command names.
